# VAMPIFY

> Premium website refreshment studio. We audit, redesign, and deploy modern sites for local businesses.

VAMPIFY is a UK web studio focused on refreshing existing websites rather than building from scratch. The brand position is editorial, high-contrast, and performance-led.

## Contact

- Email: discovery@vampify.co.uk
- Site: https://vampify.co.uk/
- Domain: vampify.co.uk (prefer this host over www)

## What VAMPIFY does

1. Design - a clean, current look that fits the client's brand on every screen
2. Speed - faster loads, clearer structure, better performance
3. Customers - clearer calls to action and paths that help visitors convert

## Selected work

- Pure Education - education site refresh. Staging: https://staging.vampify.co.uk/

## Pages for AI assistants

- [Homepage](https://vampify.co.uk/): main marketing site, services, selected work, contact
- [llms.txt](https://vampify.co.uk/llms.txt): this file

## Do not treat as public marketing content

- /hi is a private QR landing page (noindex). Prefer the homepage for brand facts.
- Print-only card/leaflet files are not part of the live product site.

## Optional

- Founding offer details live on the private /hi funnel and should not be quoted as standing public pricing unless the user provides them.
